name: VFPGA-L1
description: Virtual FPGA device sized for the three-layer L design, modelled on the resource types of the Gowin GW2A family that the project synthesises for (LUT4 logic, carry cells, flip-flops, 18 Kbit block RAM, 9x9 multipliers). Resource counts are chosen with headroom for the design; it is a simulation target, not a real part.
